scope.summary: Implement the anus module (spec 13.21; PREQ-012): anus position, gape states (closed to extreme gape as multi-key pose+morph composites with manifold interior), and pucker detail channels, present on all bodies via the base topology, with the anal canal axis registered as a ProximityDriver receiver for MT-556.
acceptance_criteria: Channels registered with stable ids: anus_position (placement), anus_gape (closed to extreme gape, multi-key track), pucker_detail (detail-map weight), plus interior canal depth; all masked to the anus region.
Gape states are rigged: anus bone set (MT-514) plus morph composite reaches extreme gape with a manifold interior; gape states export as pose+blendshape pairs (MT-612 contract).
The anal canal axis registers as a ProximityDriver receiver per the MT-534 contract (consumed by MT-556).
The module works on every body configuration - male, female, futa - since the region lives in base topology (MT-546).
scope.risk_if_missed: Anal is a top production category; without rigged gape states and a registered canal receiver, anal penetration correctives (MT-556) have no anchor and gape shots require destructive per-scene mesh edits.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
